symptoms: Calf cramp on leaving the chamber.
resolution: Lasted four hours and resolved spontaneously.

symptoms: Progressive foot pain.
resolution: Resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Altered elbow sensation.
resolution: Unchanged for a day before resolving during treatment.

symptoms: Knee soreness and tingling, with later reduced pinprick in the leg.
resolution: Worsened the next day and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Arm pain with paresthesias.
resolution: Improved during descent, returned over 12 hours. Mild soreness remained after treatment.

symptoms: Shoulder pain and altered arm sensation.
resolution: Residual shoulder tightness after treatment.

symptoms: Foot tingling spread to the thigh.
resolution: Unchanged during descent and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Tingling on the right side of the body.
resolution: Resolved 30 minutes after flight.

symptoms: Hand tingling followed by arm soreness, fullness and stiffness in the wrist and hand.
resolution: Resolved spontaneously after 12 hours.

symptoms: Warmth and tingling on the ball of the foot.
resolution: Resolved during descent 30 minutes later.

symptoms: Moderate arm pain.
resolution: Improved during descent and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Hand tingling and mild shoulder pain.
resolution: Unchanged during descent and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: In-flight shoulder pain, followed 90 minutes after flight by disorientation, nausea and difficulty with serial subtraction.
resolution: Shoulder pain lasted 23 minutes. The later symptoms resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Hand numbness, tingling and decreased grip strength.
treatment: USN Table 6, then hyperbaric oxygen the next day
resolution: Improved with the first treatment and resolved after the second.

symptoms: Foot numbness.
resolution: Resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Knee pain was greater standing or walking than seated.
resolution: Present at bedtime and resolved by morning.

symptoms: Transient arm pain progressed to tingling and repeatedly returned overnight.
resolution: Resolved by morning.

symptoms: Intermittent foot cramp.
resolution: Persisted until descent.

symptoms: Mild fatigue and a dull shoulder ache reported during the 24-hour call.
resolution: Symptoms lasted two hours.

symptoms: Hip and knee discomfort, leg tingling and calf cramps.
resolution: Almost resolved during treatment and fully resolved the next day.

symptoms: Hand paresthesia and forearm tingling.
resolution: Symptoms lasted one hour and resolved before descent.

symptoms: Elbow pain and reduced hand sensation.
resolution: Improved on descent. Slightly reduced fine touch persisted on the palm after treatment.

symptoms: Calf pain and reduced pinprick.
resolution: Improved on descent and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Hip pain.
resolution: Resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Burning, fullness and tingling of the hand.
resolution: Resolved during descent at 4,000 ft.

symptoms: Knee pain.
resolution: Improved on descent, nearly cleared on surface oxygen, and resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

symptoms: Mild constant knee pain.
resolution: Resolved 81 minutes later before descent.

symptoms: Altered hand sensation.
resolution: Reduced intensity 25 hours after onset, then resolved by the next day.

symptoms: Reduced arm sensation and pinprick in a C5 distribution.
resolution: Mild residual numbness cleared by the next day.

symptoms: Mild elbow pain.
resolution: Improved on descent and resolved during treatment.

symptoms: Bilateral forearm pain and paresthesias.
resolution: Improved on descent and surface oxygen. Resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

symptoms: Shoulder and elbow pain and reduced hand sensation.
resolution: Improved on descent and resolved on surface oxygen before hyperbaric treatment.

symptoms: Elbow pain recurred after flight and after a hot shower, with numbness over the deltoid.
resolution: The initial pain resolved in 30 minutes. Recurring symptoms resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

symptoms: Dull shoulder pain.
resolution: Improved during descent and treatment. Resolved by the 48-hour check.

symptoms: Mild elbow pain.
resolution: Lasted two hours and resolved spontaneously before descent.

symptoms: Arm pain, tingling, numbness and altered thermal sensation.
resolution: Initially cleared on surface oxygen, returned on air, and resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

symptoms: Tingling and numbness of the hand, forearm and foot.
treatment: USN Table 6 followed by hyperbaric oxygen
resolution: Foot symptoms cleared with the first treatment and residual hand numbness with the second.

symptoms: Sharp arm pain progressed to numbness.
resolution: Improved on descent. Remaining shoulder soreness cleared the next day.

symptoms: Arm tingling, coldness, numbness and reduced strength.
resolution: Resolved during treatment.

resolution: Resolved during treatment. Appendix A describes a separate preflight shoulder complaint during the same profile.
